items.headline: Benjamin Sesko progressing well in recovery from injury
items.summary: Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko is continuing his recovery from injury, having missed pre-season friendlies. Club indicated he is 'getting there'.

items.headline: Manchester United beat Rosenborg 5-0 in pre-season friendly
items.summary: Manchester United defeated Rosenborg 5-0 in a pre-season friendly in Norway, with Shea Lacey scoring the opening goal.

items.headline: Kit Margetson joins Manchester United from Swansea
items.summary: Manchester United completed their fifth signing of the summer window with 19-year-old goalkeeper Kit Margetson joining from Swansea.

items.headline: Tynan Thompson completes Manchester United move
items.summary: Manchester United confirmed the signing of Tynan Thompson, completing another arrival in the summer transfer window.
